Company description:
SCOR, one of the world’s largest reinsurers, serves more than 5,000 clients worldwide, providing a diversified and innovative range of solutions to control and manage risk. SCOR delivers advanced financial solutions, analytics and services across all dimensions of risk in Life & Health, Property & Casualty, and Investments. 

Reinsurance lies at the intersection of technical expertise and scientific progress. Models, data, and pricing and reserving tools are essential, yet they are never sufficient on their own. Sound risk decisions require expert judgment, experience and perspective. This is what we call the Art and Science of Risk. Reinsurance is a knowledge industry, where expertise grows through accumulation, transmission and practice. 

Across the Group, 3,600 experts based in more than 35 offices worldwide contribute to this collective intelligence. Actuaries, underwriters, risk management specialists, and Tech & Data experts transform data into insight, explore extreme scenarios, define the boundaries of insurability and help anticipate emerging risks. Together, they strengthen the resilience of SCOR, our clients and the societies we serve. 

This expertise is built through shared experience,continuous questioning and collective reflection. Like artists, we belong to schools of thought, learning first to observe, then to replicate, and ultimately to innovate. This ongoing transmission of knowledge enables SCOR to develop a distinctive approach, combining rigor, creativity and long-term vision in the service of risk mastery. 

This shared commitment underpins SCOR’s role as a global reinsurer. By turning risk into resilience and sustainable value, our collective of experts acts with responsibility and purpose. Together, we help protect the future, and shape it, for our clients, for society and for generations to come.

Company description:
The Swiss Climate Foundation supports small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) whose actions help protect our climate. Any company with up to 250 employees in Switzerland and/or Liechtenstein is invited to apply for funding. The Foundation funds projects in three areas as follows:

-	Measures to improve energy efficiency in the company
-	Innovative climate-protection solutions 
-	Goals agreed voluntarily with the government by the energy agency of the economy (Energieagentur der Wirtschaft, EnAW) or with Cleantech Agency Switzerland (act)

Since June 2017, the Swiss Climate Foundation has also been promoting the rejuvenation of forests that are difficult to access. The aim is to prevent the forests from overaging, becoming unstable and turning into a CO2 source should they die. The Foundation is working together on the forest programme with WaldSchweiz and the Konferenz der Kantonsförster (Conference of Cantonal Foresters).

The Foundation is a partnership of renowned service providers based in Switzerland and Liechtenstein, including banks, insurance companies and consultancies. Their commitment is a voluntary initiative by business for business, by large firms for small firms. Being service providers and therefore low energy users with low carbon emissions, these firms are refunded more of the payroll-based CO2 incentive tax than they pay in. If they are members of the partnership, they donate these net refunds rebates to the Foundation. 

Would your SME like to apply for funding? Or is your company interested in joining our partnership?

Company description:
SCOR, one of the world’s largest reinsurers, serves more than 5,000 clients worldwide, providing a diversified and innovative range of solutions to control and manage risk. SCOR delivers advanced financial solutions, analytics and services across all dimensions of risk in Life & Health, Property & Casualty, and Investments. 

Reinsurance lies at the intersection of technical expertise and scientific progress. Models, data, and pricing and reserving tools are essential, yet they are never sufficient on their own. Sound risk decisions require expert judgment, experience and perspective. This is what we call the Art and Science of Risk. Reinsurance is a knowledge industry, where expertise grows through accumulation, transmission and practice.

Like artists, we belong to schools of thought, learning first to observe, then to replicate, and ultimately to innovate. This ongoing transmission of knowledge enables SCOR to develop a distinctive approach, combining rigor, creativity and long-term vision in the service of risk mastery. 

This shared commitment underpins SCOR’s role as a global reinsurer. By turning risk into resilience and sustainable value, our collective of experts acts with responsibility and purpose. Together, we help protect the future, and shape it, for our clients, for society and for generations to come.

Over herstel, perspectief en het terugvinden van regie wanneer gezondheid, werk, inkomen en toekomst ineens onzeker zijn geworden. Jaarlijks ondersteunen wij ongeveer 30.000 mensen die letsel oplopen door een verkeers- of bedrijfsongeval. Mijn ambitie is dat zij kunnen rekenen op persoonlijke, snelle en transparante dienstverlening. Dienstverlening die niet alleen gericht is op een financiële vergoeding, maar vooral op wat iemand nodig heeft om verder te kunnen. Als senior manager bij Achmea Personenschade werk ik samen met ruim 350 hoogopgeleide kennisprofessionals. Van letselschadebehandelaars en schaderegelaars tot arbeidsdeskundigen en medisch adviseurs. Professionals die dagelijks complexe juridische, medische, financiële en menselijke vraagstukken verbinden om klanten verder te helpen. Ik geloof dat hoogwaardige dienstverlening begint bij vakmanschap. Daarom investeren we continu in de ontwikkeling van onze professionals, de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening en het vermogen om te leren en te verbeteren. Met data, feedback van klanten en de expertise van onze medewerkers werken we iedere dag aan betere hulp en vergoedingen voor mensen met letsel. De positie van Achmea brengt ook een bredere verantwoordelijkheid met zich mee. De uitdagingen binnen de letselschade kan geen enkele organisatie alleen oplossen. Daarom zet ik mij actief in voor samenwerking binnen de sector, onder meer als voorzitter van het Platform Letselschade van het Verbond van Verzekeraars. Ik geloof dat vooruitgang ontstaat wanneer verzekeraars, belangenbehartigers, deskundigen en andere partijen gezamenlijk werken aan een faire, menselijke en toekomstbestendige letselschadebehandeling. De vraag die mij daarbij steeds bezighoudt is: hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen met letsel sneller duidelijkheid krijgen, beter worden ondersteund en meer regie ervaren in een moeilijke periode van hun leven?Op LinkedIn deel ik mijn visie op ontwikkelingen binnen het vakgebied, inzichten uit de praktijk en ideeën over leiderschap, vakmanschap en dienstverlening. Om kennis te delen, van elkaar te leren en het gesprek te voeren over hoe we samen de dienstverlening voor mensen met letsel verder kunnen verbeteren. Werk je in of rondom de letselschade? Dan nodig ik je graag uit om ervaringen uit te wisselen en het gesprek aan te gaan.

With 10.2 million customers, we are the largest insurance company in the Netherlands. We help people protect what they hold dear. At the same time, as a service provider we are building a society in which people remain healthy for longer, live safely and happily, travel smartly and easily, are financially fit, enjoy work and do business openly and freely.

Headline: Head of Engineering | SaaS, Product mgt and AI enabled engineering
Bio:
Als het complex wordt, kom ik op stoom — en help ik het simpel te maken.

Toen ik ooit begon als tester, nam ik mijn werk bloedserieus. Ik had een nieuwe functionaliteit grondig getest — alles werkte perfect. Dacht ik. Maar de klant was niet blij. Dus ging ik mee om het met eigen ogen te zien. Daar ontdekte ik: hun verwachtingen waren totaal anders. Vanaf dat moment zat ik naast de klant. Ik voerde de moeilijke gesprekken, de leuke, en alles daartussenin. De klanten? Die waren blij! En zonder dat ik het doorhad, stuurde ik binnen een paar maanden het hele team aan. 

Van daaruit groeide ik door: van teamlead naar manager, naar het leiden van grotere, multidisciplinaire teams. Eerst binnen één locatie, later verspreid over meerdere landen. Ik heb zelfs near shoring sites opgezet. Wat bleef, is mijn rol als brug tussen klant en realisatie — tussen strategie, uitvoering en technologie. 

Wat mij drijft, noem ik weleens een moderne kunstvorm genaamd SaaS: de kracht van schaalbaarheid zó inzetten dat het voelt als maatwerk. Software dat voelt als een maatpak, maar eigenlijk confectie is. Het liefst op het snijvlak van mensen, technologie en producten — daar waar ideeën vorm krijgen, teams kunnen bouwen, en complexiteit een heldere richting nodig heeft.

En ja — ik hou van rennen. Letterlijk én figuurlijk. Dus stuur me gerust een bericht, ook als het over hardlopen of Artificial Intelligence gaat. Iedere week ben ik weer verbaasd over de mogelijkheden van AI🚀

SCOR, one of the world’s largest reinsurers, serves more than 5,000 clients worldwide, providing a diversified and innovative range of solutions to control and manage risk. SCOR delivers advanced financial solutions, analytics and services across all dimensions of risk in Life & Health, Property & Casualty, and Investments. 

Reinsurance lies at the intersection of technical expertise and scientific progress. Models, data, and pricing and reserving tools are essential, yet they are never sufficient on their own. Sound risk decisions require expert judgment, experience and perspective. This is what we call the Art and Science of Risk. Reinsurance is a knowledge industry, where expertise grows through accumulation, transmission and practice. 

Across the Group, 3,600 experts based in more than 35 offices worldwide contribute to this collective intelligence. Actuaries, underwriters, risk management specialists, and Tech & Data experts transform data into insight, explore extreme scenarios, define the boundaries of insurability and help anticipate emerging risks. Together, they strengthen the resilience of SCOR, our clients and the societies we serve. 

This expertise is built through shared experience,continuous questioning and collective reflection. Like artists, we belong to schools of thought, learning first to observe, then to replicate, and ultimately to innovate. This ongoing transmission of knowledge enables SCOR to develop a distinctive approach, combining rigor, creativity and long-term vision in the service of risk mastery. 

This shared commitment underpins SCOR’s role as a global reinsurer. By turning risk into resilience and sustainable value, our collective of experts acts with responsibility and purpose. Together, we help protect the future, and shape it, for our clients, for society and for generations to come.

SCOR, one of the world’s largest reinsurers, serves more than 5,000 clients worldwide, providing a diversified and innovative range of solutions to control and manage risk. SCOR delivers advanced financial solutions, analytics and services across all dimensions of risk in Life & Health, Property & Casualty, and Investments. 

Reinsurance lies at the intersection of technical expertise and scientific progress. Models, data, and pricing and reserving tools are essential, yet they are never sufficient on their own. Sound risk decisions require expert judgment, experience and perspective. This is what we call the Art and Science of Risk. Reinsurance is a knowledge industry, where expertise grows through accumulation, transmission and practice. 

Across the Group, 3,600 experts based in more than 35 offices worldwide contribute to this collective intelligence. Actuaries, underwriters, risk management specialists, and Tech & Data experts transform data into insight, explore extreme scenarios, define the boundaries of insurability and help anticipate emerging risks. Together, they strengthen the resilience of SCOR, our clients and the societies we serve. 

This expertise is built through shared experience,continuous questioning and collective reflection. Like artists, we belong to schools of thought, learning first to observe, then to replicate, and ultimately to innovate. This ongoing transmission of knowledge enables SCOR to develop a distinctive approach, combining rigor, creativity and long-term vision in the service of risk mastery. 

This shared commitment underpins SCOR’s role as a global reinsurer. By turning risk into resilience and sustainable value, our collective of experts acts with responsibility and purpose. Together, we help protect the future, and shape it, for our clients, for society and for generations to come.

SCOR, one of the world’s largest reinsurers, serves more than 5,000 clients worldwide, providing a diversified and innovative range of solutions to control and manage risk. SCOR delivers advanced financial solutions, analytics and services across all dimensions of risk in Life & Health, Property & Casualty, and Investments.

Reinsurance is a knowledge industry, where expertise grows through accumulation, transmission and practice. 

Across the Group, 3,600 experts based in more than 35 offices worldwide contribute to this collective intelligence. Actuaries, underwriters, risk management specialists, and Tech & Data experts transform data into insight, explore extreme scenarios, define the boundaries of insurability and help anticipate emerging risks. Together, they strengthen the resilience of SCOR, our clients and the societies we serve. 

This expertise is built through shared experience,continuous questioning and collective reflection. Like artists, we belong to schools of thought, learning first to observe, then to replicate, and ultimately to innovate. This ongoing transmission of knowledge enables SCOR to develop a distinctive approach, combining rigor, creativity and long-term vision in the service of risk mastery. 

This shared commitment underpins SCOR’s role as a global reinsurer. By turning risk into resilience and sustainable value, our collective of experts acts with responsibility and purpose. Together, we help protect the future, and shape it, for our clients, for society and for generations to come.

Throughout my career, I have naturally gravitated towards building platforms, operating models and ways of working that continue creating value long after individual projects have finished. What continues to inspire me is exploring how intelligence evolves – and helping build systems that allow people and organisations to become wiser together.
